S_VERSION.description: Do nothing. This opcode is used to specify the microcode version for tools that interpret shader microcode.

GLOBAL_PREFETCH_B8.description: Load byte into L1 cache. Does not return any data to VGPRs. Does not alter shader dependency counters.

V_MOV_B32.description: Move 32-bit data from a vector input into a vector register.

V_READLANE_B32.description: Read the scalar value in the specified lane of the first input where the lane select is in the second input. Store the result into a scalar register.

V_WRITELANE_B32.description: Write the scalar value in the first input into the specified lane of a vector register where the lane select is in the second input.

LLVM_lane_EXEC_references.quote: These are special and do not read the exec mask.

lane_behavior: V_READLANE reads SRC0 VGPR lane selected by SRC1=inline0, independent of EXEC.
The installed code forces EXEC_LO=1 on this wave32 path. V_MOV writes zero only to DST-selected VGPR lane0.
V_WRITELANE writes saved scalar ttmp15 to DST-selected VGPR lane0, independent of EXEC. It does not broadcast to lane16 or other lanes.
The installed sequence restores the original EXEC_LO afterward. The net register effect under ordinary semantics is a full32-bit cross-bank copy at lane0 when SRC0 and DST differ.
GLOBAL_PREFETCH uses the SRC0-selected logical v1 in the LLVM model; it does not return a register value. Its memory and timing effects are not modeled.
conditional_causal_examples: SRC0bank1/DSTbank0 (low modes01,05 and other unused-field variants) copies historical v257 lane0 into v1 lane0.
SRC0bank1/DSTbank2 (low modes81,85 and other unused-field variants) copies historical v257 lane0 into v513 lane0.
Current three-arm target low modes46,4a,42 all have SRC0bank2/DSTbank1, giving the reverse copy v513 lane0 into v257 lane0 if entry occurs at those inherited bank settings.
architecture_evidence_and_limit: The first-level source itself later saves/clears shader DST/SRC0/SRC1 bank fields to use v0..255, supporting inherited-bank significance in privileged code. No independent architectural guarantee or runtime observation establishes MODE on actual entry to this early workaround. Ordinary decoding plus this intent is a concrete conditional candidate, not a proven observed trap-mediated fault.
geometry_limit: Physical lane16 is untouched by this early sequence. An observed lane16 output requires downstream routing/arithmetic or another mechanism; downstream B-permute/WMMA correlation is delegated to the independent tail_result_audit peer.
